name: share
description: REELDROP — Retro Modern Movie Archive (Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS)

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','script.js','favicon.ico'].forEach(f=>fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.copyFileSync(f,'public/'+f)); if(fs.existsSync('images')) fs.cpSync('images','public/images',{recursive:true}); console.log('Static public directory created successfully');"
